title: OJAJ etap I gram.-leks.: formy czasownika

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania poprawnymi formami czasownikow podanych w nawiasach. Uzywaj pelnych form, np. does not zamiast doesn't.

items.context: What were you doing when the boss _________ you at noon? (ring)
When we got to the party, everybody _________ and the place was completely quiet. (already leave)
I don't know, why he _________ - it's so simple! (not understand)
_________ Polish in our Spanish class is strictly forbidden. (speak)
I _________ 4 coffees today, that's enough, thanks. (already have)
I didn't realize how difficult it is _________ in England. (drive)
Karen hates it when her husband _________ in the shower. (whistle)
She _________ the attic all morning and that's why she is so tired. (cleaning)
I can't give you the soup. It _________ . (still/prepare)
I'm sure I _________ decorating the Christmas tree by 5p.m. (finish)
More and more people _________ their lifestyles, e.g. a lot of my friends have stopped eating sweets. (change)
I wish I _________ some rest just after I finished my exams - now I'm so tired! (have)
